stem.text: A musical instrument is made using a long tube with a mouthpiece at one end. The other end is open and flared, as shown.

stem.alt: Long tube with a mouthpiece at the left end and a flared open end at the right.

stem.text: A musician maintains stationary sound waves with a node at the mouthpiece and an antinode at the other end. The lowest frequency of sound that the instrument can produce is $92\,\text{Hz}$.
Which different frequencies of sound can be produced by the instrument?
